target_customer: Quant funds and traders who need data science on large market datasets
problem: Quant researchers spend time wrangling data and infrastructure; Sharpe offers an AI research agent that runs multi step analyses and outputs reproducible notebooks.
business_model: B2B SaaS, enterprise sales with pricing page
product_category: AI research agent for quantitative finance

founders.name: Vivek Hazari
founders.background_notes: Spent two years at Palantir and helped lead a team on AIP per the YC page.

founders.name: Daniel DiPietro
founders.background_notes: First author papers at NeurIPS and CoRL per the YC page.

founders.name: John McCambridge
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as founder and CTO or CPO and a former high frequency trading engineer; employer not named.

founders.name: Ziray Hao
founders.background_notes: Listed as one of four founders (Dartmouth friends) of Lumenary/Sharpe per https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/sharpe; role and background not otherwise sourced.

technical_complexity.rationale: Orchestrating agents over very large financial datasets with reproducibility requires solid data infrastructure but builds on existing LLMs.

defensibility.rationale: Bundled data and infrastructure help, but agent workflows were easy to imitate.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents later shipped agents: Bloomberg introduced AskB in February 2026 and AlphaSense added research agents.

market_need_then: The YC page claims Sharpe helped a top 5 quant firm find $10M or more of profit within hours of deployment; this is a company claim.

branding.domain_note: sharpe.sh domain; legal entity Lumenary, Inc. per site
branding.brand_signature: Name echoes the quant Sharpe ratio (inference, not stated by sources)

brand_strength.rationale: Name is relevant to quants but collides with the open source 'sharpe' library and Sharpely AI; no brand press found.

outcome_analysis: Sharpe is an early stage quant research agent from the Lumenary team, which also built the Solar app builder. No outcome event or verified funding was found, and large incumbents moved into agentic finance research in 2026, so its position is still unproven.
notes: Funding unverified: VCBacked lists $500K pre-seed for Lumenary and Dealroom lists $2.2M, with mismatched descriptions, so nothing is recorded. Name origin is not stated. The legal entity is Lumenary, Inc. and the YC page says the team built Solar; the relationship to Sharpe is not fully clear. No dated competitors near the batch were found. Completeness pass: the 500K pre-seed in September 2024 is listed for Lumenary, Inc. (VCBacked and Caplight, databases only); Dealroom instead lists 2.2M with no date, a conflict left unreconciled. VCBacked's description of Lumenary as financial research conflicts with YC and may be a mix-up.
